skills.description: Builds arc42-aligned C4 Context/Container/Component views as an HTML index site (not Markdown). Use when assembling architecture visualization outputs.

Orchestrator Manager strategy for CSA — bootstraps shared swarm memory, fans out specialist subagents in parallel, gates via Completeness Validator, re-runs up to 2 times, then assembles CSA pack. Use as the primary workflow orchestrator agent.
Shared CSA artifact metadata, ID conventions, confidence scoring, and evidence reference rules. Use when producing or validating any CSA specialist artifact JSON.
Extract DDD domains, entities, business rules, and capabilities from legacy code for CSA. Use when Manager invokes Business Domain analysis.
Validates CSA specialist artifacts against JSON Schema and gate rubrics; emits pass/fail gate reports with remediation briefs. Use after every specialist run as Manager subagent.
Field-level and entity-level data lineage for legacy CSA. Use when Manager invokes Data Lineage analysis.
Technology inventory and artifact classification for legacy CSA discovery. Use when the Manager invokes Discover or when classifying a legacy codebase stack, modules, and dependencies.

Assembles Hybrid CSA pack — Markdown deliverables plus arc42-C4 HTML index — and Markdown epic/story seeds from accepted machine artifacts. Use when Manager invokes Document Assembler after gated specialists.
Classify legacy integrations (REST/EVENT/BATCH/LEGACY), sync vs async, and resilience patterns for CSA. Use when Manager invokes Integration Analysis.
Shared-memory protocol for CSA Orchestrator swarm — swarm_state, handoffs, context_memory, and artifact index so parallel specialists sync outputs. Use for Manager bootstrap and every subagent turn.
Runtime-aware technical architecture, C4 layers, components, and tech debt for CSA. Use when Manager invokes Technology Architecture analysis.
Standard structure for CSA data architecture and lineage documentation. Use during Data Lineage analysis and Assembler section 06.
DDD structuring for CSA domain model — bounded contexts, aggregates, entities, and business rules as Markdown. Use during Business Domain analysis and Assembler domain docs.
Maps CSA capabilities and traceability into Function, Epic, and Story seeds as Markdown for modernization backlog generation. Use during Document Assembler and epic-story readiness gate.
Rules for citing file paths, line ranges, and artifact kinds on CSA claims. Use when writing specialist artifacts or validating evidence coverage.
Quality gate for CSA domain.json. Use when validating Business Domain specialist output.
Quality gate for assembled csa_pack Markdown sections, arc42-C4 HTML index, and machine artifacts. Use after Document Assembler.
Quality gate for CSA lineage.json. Use when validating Data Lineage specialist output.
Quality gate for CSA discovery.json. Use when Completeness Validator evaluates Discover output.
Final gate ensuring functions/epics/stories Markdown seeds are CSA-traceable before epic generation. Use after epic_story_seeds Markdown files are written.
Quality gate for CSA integration.json. Use when validating Integration specialist output.
Quality gate for CSA architecture.json. Use when validating Tech Architecture specialist output.
Detection heuristics for 20+ year legacy stacks (J2EE, .NET Framework, VB, COBOL, classic ASP, ESB, batch). Use during Discover and when validating stack claims.

Detection heuristics for IBM MQ (native com.ibm.mq and JMS) queue managers, channels, queues, and put/get patterns in legacy Java. Use during Discover and Integration analysis. Do not hardcode customer queue names.

Detection and documentation heuristics for legacy stored procedures, packages, and ORM call sites (PL/SQL, TopLink, iBatis/MyBatis, JDBC CallableStatement). Use during Discover, Domain, Data Lineage, and Completeness validation. Do not hardcode customer package names.

Author and render Mermaid diagrams correctly in CSA Markdown and arc42-C4 HTML. Use whenever Assembler, arc42-c4-views, DDD, lineage, or integration docs need architecture/domain/lineage/integration diagrams.
Shared CSA quality gate contract, scoring dimensions, severity rules, and remediation brief format. Use when Completeness Validator or Manager evaluates specialist artifacts.
